ABOUT_DESCRIPTION: ICQbot was inspired by ScratchJr.ScratchJr is an introductory programming language that enables young children (ages 5-7) to create their own interactive stories and games. Children snap together graphical programming blocks to make characters move, jump, dance, and sing. Children can use the programming blocks to make their characters come to life.
ABOUT_INSPIRED_BY: ICQbot has gone through a series of enhancements in terms of functionality, mainly focusing on introducing new program building blocks and increasing the ability to connect with robots. Through these new building blocks, children can learn how to program and control robots to perform various actions and complete multiple tasks, and children can more intuitively understand the working principle of robots and the application scenarios of automation technology. ICQbot also offers richer creative resources such as a wider variety of characters and backgrounds, providing a more challenging and diverse learning experience for children.
ABOUT_WHY_CREATE_DESCRIPTION:
ICQbot is designed to inspire kids' interest in technology and engineering while fostering their innovation and hands-on skills. In ICQbot, kids can easily create interactive stories and games using graphically programmed building blocks, and delve into the mysteries of technology and engineering by controlling the robot to perform various tasks. This intuitive and fun way to learn not only allows children to enjoy programming, but also stimulates their desire to explore technology and engineering.

ICQbot provides kids with a fun and creative learning environment that helps them build an interest in programming and technology at an early age, laying a solid foundation for their future learning and development.

BLOCKS_GREEN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION: Starts the script when the Green Flag is tapped.
BLOCKS_ON_TAP_DESCRIPTION: Starts the script when you tap on the character.
BLOCKS_ON_TOUCH_DESCRIPTION: Starts the script when the character is touched by another character.
BLOCKS_ON_MESSAGE_DESCRIPTION: Starts the script whenever a message of the specified color is sent.
BLOCKS_SEND_MESSAGE_DESCRIPTION: Sends a message of the specified color.
BLOCKS_MOVE_RIGHT_DESCRIPTION: Moves the character a specified number of grid squares to the right.
BLOCKS_MOVE_LEFT_DESCRIPTION: Moves the character a specified number of grid squares to the left.
BLOCKS_MOVE_UP_DESCRIPTION: Moves the character a specified number of grid squares up.
BLOCKS_MOVE_DOWN_DESCRIPTION: Moves the character a specified number of grid squares down.
BLOCKS_TURN_RIGHT_DESCRIPTION: Rotates the character clockwise a specified amount. Turn 12 for a full rotation.
BLOCKS_TURN_LEFT_DESCRIPTION: Rotates the character counterclockwise a specified amount. Turn 12 for a full rotation.
BLOCKS_HOP_DESCRIPTION: Moves the character up a specified number of grid squares and then down again.
BLOCKS_GO_HOME_DESCRIPTION: Resets the character's location to its starting position. (To set a new starting position, drag the character to the location).
BLOCKS_SAY_DESCRIPTION: Shows a specified message in a speech bubble above the character.
BLOCKS_RESET_SIZE_DESCRIPTION: Returns the character to its default size.
BLOCKS_HIDE_DESCRIPTION: Fades out the character until it is invisible.
BLOCKS_SHOW_DESCRIPTION: Fades in the character until it is fully visible.
BLOCKS_PLAY_RECORDED_DESCRIPTION: Plays a sound recorded by the user.
BLOCKS_WAIT_DESCRIPTION: Pauses the script for a specified amount of time (in tenths of seconds).
BLOCKS_SET_SPEED_DESCRIPTION: Changes the rate at which certain blocks are run.
BLOCKS_REPEAT_DESCRIPTION: Runs the blocks inside a specified number of times.
BLOCKS_END_DESCRIPTION: Indicates the end of the script (but does not affect the script in any way).
BLOCKS_REPEAT_FOREVER_DESCRIPTION: Runs the script over and over.
BLOCKS_GO_TO_PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Changes to the specified page of the project.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_SAVE_DESCRIPTION: Save the current project and exit to the Home page.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_STAGE_DESCRIPTION: This is where the action takes place in the project. To delete a character, press and hold it.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_PRESENTATION_MODE_DESCRI: Expand the stage to the full screen.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_GRID_DESCRIPTION: Toggle on (and off) the x-y coordinate grid.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_CHANGE_BG_DESCRIPTION: Select or create a background image for the stage.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_ADD_TEXT_DESCRIPTION: Write titles and labels on the stage.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_RESET_CHAR_DESCRIPTION: Reset all characters to their starting positions on the stage. (Drag characters to set up new starting positions.)
INTERFACE_GUIDE_GREEN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION: Start all programming scripts that begin with a "Start on Green Flag" block by tapping here.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_PAGES_DESCRIPTION: Select among the pages in your project — or tap the plus sign to add a new page. Each page has its own set of characters and a background. To delete a page, press and hold it. To reorder pages, drag them to new positions.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_PROJECT_INFO_DESCRIPTION: Change the title of the project, see when the project was created, and share the project (if supported by your device).
INTERFACE_GUIDE_UNDO_REDO_DESCRIPTION: If you make a mistake, tap Undo to go back in time, reversing the last action. Tap Redo to reverse the last Undo.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_PROGRAMMING_SCRIPT_DESCR: Snap blocks together to make a programming script, telling the character what to do. Tap anywhere on a script to make it run. To delete a block or script, drag it outside the programming area. To copy a block or script from one character to another, drag it onto the character's thumbnail.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_PROGRAMMING_AREA_DESCRIP: This is where you connect programming blocks to create scripts, telling the character what to do.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_BLOCKS_PALETTE_DESCRIPTI: This is the menu of programming blocks. Drag a block into the programming area, then tap on it to see what it does.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_BLOCKS_CATEGORIES_DESCRI: This is where you can select a category of programming blocks: Triggering Blocks (Yellow), Motion (Blue), Looks (Purple), Sounds (Green), Control (Orange), End Blocks (Red).
INTERFACE_GUIDE_CHARACTERS_DESCRIPTION: Select among the characters in your project — or tap the plus sign to add a new one. Once a character is selected, you can edit its scripts, tap its name to rename it, or tap the paintbrush to edit its image. To delete a character, press and hold it. To copy a character to another page, drag it to the page thumbnail.
PAINT_GUIDE_SHAPE_DESCRIPTION: Choose a shape to draw: line, circle/ellipse, rectangle, or triangle.
PAINT_GUIDE_CHARACTER_NAME_DESCRIPTION: Edit the name of the character.
PAINT_GUIDE_CUT_DESCRIPTION: After selecting the Cut tool, you can tap a character or shape to remove it from the canvas.
PAINT_GUIDE_DUPLICATE_DESCRIPTION: After selecting the Duplicate tool, you can tap a character or shape to create a copy of it.
PAINT_GUIDE_ROTATE_DESCRIPTION: After selecting the Rotate tool, you can rotate a character or shape around its center.
PAINT_GUIDE_DRAG_DESCRIPTION: After selecting the Drag tool, you can drag a character or shape on the canvas. If you tap on a shape, you can then edit the shape by dragging the dots that appear.
PAINT_GUIDE_SAVE_DESCRIPTION: Save changes and leave the Paint Editor.
PAINT_GUIDE_FILL_DESCRIPTION: After selecting the Fill tool, you can tap any section of a character or shape to fill it with the currently selected color.
PAINT_GUIDE_CAMERA_DESCRIPTION: After selecting the Camera tool, you can tap any section of a character or shape, and then tap the camera button to fill the section with a new photo taken with the camera.
PAINT_GUIDE_COLOR_DESCRIPTION: Select a new color to use for drawing and filling in shapes.
PAINT_GUIDE_LINE_WIDTH_DESCRIPTION: Change the width of the lines in the shapes you are drawing.
BLOCKS_ON_TILT_DESCRIPTION: Starts the script when the tilt sensor detects a change.
BLOCKS_ON_Distance_DESCRIPTION: Starts the script when the distance sensor detects a change.
BLOCKS_ON_Button_DESCRIPTION: Starts the script when the button is pressed.
BLOCKS_ON_SPEECH: When a voice command is recognized
BLOCKS_ON_SPEECH_DESCRIPTION: Start the script when a voice command is recognized
BLOCKS_LED_DESCRIPTION: Change the LED light color on the master.
BLOCKS_MotorSpeed_DESCRIPTION: Change the speed of the motor(The value ranges from 0 to 9).
BLOCKS_MotorDouble_DESCRIPTION: When two motors are connected at the same time, the motion state of the robot can be changed.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_BLE_DESCRIPTION: Click the pop-up Bluetooth connection window and select the device to connect.
INTERFACE_GUIDE_CON_DESCRIPTION: You can view the information about the currently connected device.

Dear Users,Thank you for using the ICQbot software (hereinafter referred to as 'the Software'). We highly value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information and privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information during your use of the Software.
I. How We Collect and Use Information
The Software does not require a registration process and does not upload any of your personal information to servers. While using the Software, you only need to authorize the following device permissions to ensure the proper operation of relevant functions:
Camera Permission
Purpose: To take photos of the added characters.
Special Note: Photos are stored locally on your device and will not be uploaded or shared.
Microphone Permission
Purpose: To record audio for adding sound effects to characters.
Special Note: Recorded audio is only stored and played locally and will not be uploaded or saved in the cloud.
Storage Permission
Purpose: To save and read programming projects.
Special Note: Your programming projects are stored locally on your device and will not be accessed or uploaded.
Bluetooth Permission
Purpose: To connect to hardware devices and enable interactive operations.
Special Note: Only used for Bluetooth device connections and communication; no Bluetooth connection information is recorded.
Location Permission
Purpose: Required for scanning BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) devices.
Special Note: The Software does not use location permissions to collect location information but only for the technical requirement of Bluetooth scanning.
II. How We Protect Your Information
2.1 Local Storage Security
All user data is stored locally on your device and will not be uploaded to any server or third-party platform.
2.2 Permission Requests
We only request permissions necessary for the Software's functions and will clearly explain their purposes through pop-up notifications at the time of use and obtain your consent.
2.3 Information Isolation
The Software will not actively read device information unrelated to its functions, nor will it engage in data collection, analysis, or information sharing.
2.4 Bluetooth Communication Security
During Bluetooth communication, data is transmitted only between your device and the hardware. Communication content is not recorded or disclosed.
III. Your Rights
3.1 Permission Management
You can manage the Software's permissions at any time through your device's system settings. If you revoke authorization, certain functions of the Software may be restricted, but it will not affect your use of other features.
3.2 Data Security
You have full control over all data generated during your use of the Software (such as photos, recordings, programming projects, etc.).
IV. Special Note for Juvenile Users
If you are under 18 years old, please use the Software with the consent of your guardian and under their guidance to learn how to use th e Software properly and protect your privacy.
V. Updates to the Privacy Policy
This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to comply with legal regulations or service adjustments. We will not provide separate notifications for updates. It is recommended that you regularly review this policy to stay informed of the latest information.
VI. Contact Us
